Everything that makes a door glide

A sliding door is a simple machine — until one part fails. We service every piece of it, right on your track.

Door tune-ups

Full inspection, cleaning, and realignment so the whole door works like new.

Roller replacement

Worn wheels make doors heavy. We swap in stainless rollers that last.

Track repair

Bent, pitted, or corroded tracks repaired or capped for a smooth ride.

Locks & latches

Secure your home with new mortise locks, keyed locks, and latch repairs.

Handle replacement

Broken or loose handles replaced with hardware that fits your door.

Glass replacement

Cracked or fogged panels replaced with impact-rated options available.

Screen doors

New screen doors and re-screening to keep the breeze in and bugs out.

Emergency repairs

Door stuck open or won't lock? We prioritize security calls.

From stuck to smooth in three steps

1

Call or text us

Tell us what the door is doing. We'll give you a straight answer on cost and get you on the schedule — often for today.

2

We diagnose on site

Your technician inspects the rollers, track, and hardware, then quotes the exact price before any work begins.

3

Glide with one finger

Most repairs are done in one visit with parts from the truck. We test the door with you before we leave.

The lion behind the sparkle

Magical Sliding Glass Door Repair is a local, family-run company serving South Florida homeowners. Salt air and daily use are hard on sliding doors here — we've built our whole business around fixing exactly that.

No pressure to replace a door that can be repaired. We fix what's broken, show you the old parts, and leave the track cleaner than we found it.

  • Thousands of doors repaired across Palm Beach and Broward
  • Upfront, flat-rate pricing quoted before work starts
  • Stainless and impact-rated parts built for coastal weather
